summary: Iteration 6: full backend + frontend verification of (a) pricing scope semantics fix (application_scope=unit vs line, apply_before_quantity, once_per_line) at qty=1/2/5 for WIN_PVC_STANDARD film_diff, and (b) M3.3.1 autosave endpoint /api/quotes/{id}/autosave (success flow with version bump, 409 conflict with server_data, 400 on consolidated status, whitelist enforcement, mixed whitelist+non-whitelist, tenant_id protection). 10/10 unit pytest tests_pricing_scope.py PASS. 12/12 new pytest suite test_autosave_scope_preview.py PASS end-to-end against the live preview URL. Frontend Playwright PASS: AutosaveIndicator shows idle→saved with version bump v.1→v.2, three rapid consecutive edits within debounce window produce a single autosave (v.2→v.3, diff=1), Notes/Payment inputs are disabled on 'sent' quote and AutosaveIndicator is absent (as expected), Configurator dialog now shows 1133,81 € for qty=1 and 2117,62 € for qty=2 (regression value 2267,62 € NO LONGER appears), the fixed €150 rule (Pellicolato differente +€150) is applied ONCE regardless of qty. IVA 22% breakdown consistent: qty=1 IVA=249,44 (Totale 1383,25); qty=2 IVA=465,88 (Totale 2583,50).
critical_code_review_comments: services/pricing_v2.py: 3-pass design is correct — Pass 1 evaluates scope=unit rules on per-piece running total; Pass 2 defers once_per_line=true fixed rules (still scope=unit) to line-level so they apply once; Pass 3 applies scope=line rules on line_running AFTER qty multiplication. `unit_price_pre_qty` = per-piece final BEFORE line-scope rules; `unit_price_final` = subtotal/qty (effective per-piece AFTER all rules). Deterministic sort key (priority, created_at, id) preserved.

routers/quotes.py autosave_quote: ALLOWED whitelist = {title, notes, payment_terms, delivery_days, warranty_months, valid_until, discount_pct_global, internal_notes, site_address, description}. Non-whitelist fields silently filtered; when payload is empty → 400 'Nessun campo autosalvabile'. Delegates to update_with_version() which handles consolidated-status guard (400 'Documento in stato consolidato non modificabile — creare una nuova revisione') and version conflict (409 with detail.error='version_conflict', detail.server_data, detail.expected_version, detail.current_version).

hooks/useAutosave.js: 800ms debounce timer + AbortController on the previous inflight request + request_id per attempt (used for out-of-order guard). onSuccess bumps cached version in-place via qc.setQueryData rather than refetching (avoids clobbering the user's in-flight edits). Verified: 3 sequential schedule() calls within debounce yield exactly 1 network request and exactly 1 version increment.

components/AutosaveIndicator.jsx: exposes data-testid=autosave-indicator with data-state attribute (idle|dirty|saving|saved|error|conflict); tested transition idle→saving→saved. Not rendered when editable=false (sent/consolidated statuses) — {editable && <AutosaveIndicator ... />} guard in QuoteEditorPage line 174.

QuoteEditorPage.jsx: 'editable' guard = !['accepted','converted','superseded','rejected','cancelled','expired','sent','signed'].includes(status). All form inputs (notes/payment_terms/delivery_days/warranty_months/valid_until/internal_notes) share the same disabled={!editable} attribute → verified in DOM on sent quote. Autosave.flushNow() called before status transitions (send/convert/revise) to guarantee no lost drafts.

seed_pricing.py migration: COLOR_FILM_DIFF_FIXED and ROLLER_MOTOR_* now correctly carry application_scope='line' — verified via /api/configurator/preview breakdown showing scope='line' for COLOR_FILM_DIFF_FIXED and amount=150.00 across qty=1/2/5.
Regression safety net: /api/quotes/{id} PATCH with stale If-Match still returns 409, force=true w/o X-Force-Reason still returns 400 — verified in TestConcurrencyRegression.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_autosave_scope_preview.py (new — 12 pytest tests: auth ×2, preview economics ×3, autosave success/conflict/consolidated/whitelist_all/whitelist_mixed ×5, concurrency regression ×2)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (autosave indicator idle→saved, version v.1→v.2 single edit, v.2→v.3 debounced batch of 3 edits, sent-quote inputs disabled + indicator absent, configurator qty=1 → 1133,81 € and qty=2 → 2117,62 € NOT 2267,62)

seed_data_creation: Session-scoped TEST_ quotes created via API on top of existing seed leads (no manual DB manipulation). Autosave draft quote id 4e4f24a5-1194-4654-96c3-57d66a3c7b94 (title 'TEST_UI_Autosave_iter6') and consolidated quote id a32a4520-73d2-4723-a973-829d7476531d (title 'TEST_UI_Sent_iter6', status=sent) left in DB for main-agent re-verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 test file at /app/backend/tests/test_autosave_scope_preview.py — 12 tests, ~2.2s runtime, uses fixtures s/admin_h/tenant_id/seed_lead + per-test draft_quote fixture (fresh draft quote per test to avoid state coupling across autosave scenarios). Live preview URL http://serramento-ops.preview.emergentagent.com is auto-read from /app/frontend/.env when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is not exported in shell. Autosave payload MUST include a fresh version — always GET the quote first if unsure. Consolidated statuses that block autosave: sent/viewed/negotiating/accepted/converted/superseded/rejected/expired/cancelled. Whitelist for autosave = {title, notes, payment_terms, delivery_days, warranty_months, valid_until, discount_pct_global, internal_notes, site_address, description} — any other keys are silently stripped; if only stripped keys → 400.
rca of the issue: No issue found. Both objectives of iteration 6 verified: (1) scope-semantics fix is correct end-to-end — the fixed €150 surcharge for film_diff now stays at 150,00 € regardless of qty (previously it would multiply to €300 at qty=2, €750 at qty=5); (2) autosave endpoint safely rejects consolidated docs, enforces the whitelist so tenant_id cannot be spoofed, handles optimistic-locking conflicts with a fresh server_data payload, and the FE debounces to a single network round-trip within an 800ms window as designed.
